# Evalis AI

> Evalis AI is a global AI data services and software company headquartered in Perinthalmanna, Kerala, India. We provide RLHF training data, data annotation & labeling, search quality evaluation, LLM testing & red teaming, content moderation, and localization in 20+ languages — plus full-stack web, app, and SaaS development. We are a trusted, lower-cost alternative to Appen, Telus Digital, RWS, CrowdGen, and Invisible AI, serving clients in the USA, UK, Europe, and worldwide with dedicated expert teams at 60-70% lower cost.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2024 in Perinthalmanna, Kerala, India
- Contact: info@evalisai.com | +91 95448 42260
- Services: RLHF training data, data annotation, search quality evaluation (search relevance rating), LLM red teaming & AI safety testing, DPO evaluation, content moderation, localization & translation QA (20+ languages), web development, mobile app development, SaaS development, AI agent & chatbot development, workflow automation, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Clients served: AI labs, search engines, e-commerce, healthcare, and enterprise companies worldwide
- Coverage: USA, UK, Canada, Germany, France, Netherlands, Ireland, Switzerland, Sweden, New Zealand, Australia, Singapore, UAE, India
